climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: France's only alpine wine region, known for grapes rarely grown elsewhere: Jacquère, Roussanne, Altesse and Gringet for white, and Mondeuse for red. Jacquère covers about 59% of the vineyard area and Altesse 21%.
